name: Section on road 581 north of Olofström
description: A random 1.3 km of road 581 (P.J. Rösjös väg). OSM: the hamlet Rösjö is 1.0 km from its south end, the town Olofström 2.2 km (a town wins when half its distance is less than the hamlet's: 2.2 / 2 = 1.1 is not); the hamlet Hemmingsmåla is 0.4 km from its north end, Olofström 1.9 km.
